label: copy-phase input i (sparse, mid-copy)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost only (98.6% of activation mass) when the fed-back input token is the letter i, i.e. a repeated i (in_first=0). Never fires in the original or delimiter phase; a small leftover (1.4% of mass) is on input u. It is very selective: only about 8% of copy-phase i inputs activate it, so precision is low. Rate and magnitude are highest when i is fed back around recall_idx 3-4 (orig position 2-3) and the token to output next is u, p, i, or a digit 1/2. The strongest activations are on i followed by u (e.g. o b i u -> top). Adding those position and next-token conditions raises precision to ~0.48 but drops recall to ~0.37 (F1 0.42), so the gating beyond input=i is not captured by a simple predicate.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=i (+7.18), phase=2 & in_tok=u (+6.06), in_tok=i (+4.18), phase=2 & out_tok=p (+2.87), phase=2 & out_tok=u (+2.53), orig5=1 (+2.48). Lower it: correct=1 (-4.99), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.51), recall_idx=1 (-3.51), to_go=6 (-2.97).
